scope: isolated scheduler, simulated clock, transport, outage and recovery

results.name: service recovery sends one current P1 round, keeps outage gap, never replays all missed periods
explicit check read failure reports not verified after retry, never counts a business reminder
decision changes during adapter identity read stop unsent notice
automatically closed item may reopen from new evidence, invalidating unsent result; manual closure stays protected
weekly notice created after 18:00 survives until next actual workday, then rechecks and sends once
completion requirements trigger fresh assessment despite unchanged source; time alone never resets treatment or shifts deadline
self-notice idempotency key fits verified CLI limit and only pre-request validation is definite failure
restored workspace preserves pending actions as history and cannot enable automatic execution
